title: Approve and pay a shareholder distribution
summary: When a company proposes a dividend or another distribution to its owners. A reviewed distribution decision with authorized payments, required records and reconciled ownership and tax treatment.
outcomes: A reviewed distribution decision with authorized payments, required records and reconciled ownership and tax treatment.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a company proposes a dividend or another distribution to its owners.

parts.title: Prepare the proposed distribution and ownership facts
parts.guidance: Collect current accounts, cash forecasts, ownership rights, investor agreements and the proposed amount and date. Separate cash on hand from funds legally available for distribution.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Confirm legal capacity and tax treatment
parts.guidance: Qualified company-law and tax advisers assess the entity, jurisdiction, restrictions and recipient treatment. Keep uncertain distributable amounts or required consents unresolved and block payment until reviewed.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Confirm legal capacity and tax treatment

parts.title: Draft the calculation and approval pack
parts.guidance: Prepare recipient allocations from verified rights and record the assumptions and evidence used. Reconcile rounding and currency handling without replacing the professional determination of lawful capacity.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Obtain the required corporate approvals
parts.guidance: The authorized decision-makers approve the specific amount, recipients and conditions through the reviewed governance route. Retain resolutions and any required consent before releasing funds.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Execute specifically authorized payments
parts.guidance: Authorized finance personnel independently verify recipient payment details and apply the approved payment controls. Record receipts and investigate rejected or mismatched transfers.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Reconcile records and reporting obligations
parts.guidance: Finance and advisers reconcile payments, distribution records and any applicable tax reporting or withholding. Escalate exceptions and avoid marking the distribution complete on approval alone.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

verify.how: A reviewed distribution decision with authorized payments, required records and reconciled ownership and tax treatment.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK; local distribution rules must be reviewed separately. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
